h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Srinagar

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Srinagar

items.pText: In Srinagar the outdoor working season is shorter than in most of India, because the ground freezes and snow falls through the winter months. A playground that is ordered late may have to wait for spring. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment for schools, parks, hotels and colonies in Srinagar at our factory in Vasai East, Maharashtra, about 1,650 km away.

Srinagar sits in the Kashmir valley, around the Dal Lake, with cold winters, pleasant summers and a wet spring. Equipment reaches the valley by road, and our team or a dealer in north India installs it. Tell us the size of your site and the ages of the children, with a few photos. We will then suggest equipment, send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked and help you plan the timing.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

c: Grouting needs ground that is not frozen and concrete that can set, so plan installation between late spring and autumn. Work back from that window: agree the layout and quote early, so manufacturing and road delivery finish before the cold sets in.

Through winter, galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic cope with snow and frost far better than bare metal or untreated wood. Clear snow from decks and slides before children use them, and check footings after the thaw for any movement. Lakeside sites stay damp, so give the play area a raised, drained base with rubber flooring. See our

items.q: When is a good time to install playground equipment in Srinagar?
items.a: Between late spring and autumn, when the ground is not frozen and concrete can set. Agree the layout and quote early so delivery fits that window.

items.q: Can the equipment stay outdoors through the winter?
items.a: Yes. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic handle snow and frost. Clear snow before use and check bolts and footings once the thaw begins.

items.q: Do you deliver to the Kashmir valley?
items.a: Yes. We deliver by road anywhere in India. Installation is done by our own team or a dealer in north India.
